AfterCombatEnd.maps_to: NOT PORTED -- GuiltyCard has no after-combat hook (guilty.py)
AfterCombatEnd.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 7): `Card.after_combat_end(run)` exists and Guilty implements it. `Hook.AfterCombatEnd` walks `runState.IterateHookListeners` (Hook.cs:328-335), which yields the DECK as well as the relics, and fires from `EndCombatInternal` (CombatManager.cs:988) on every combat end -- win or loss, before `Hook.AfterCombatVictory`. `RunState.finish_combat` now makes that deck pass. Because the sim keeps the run deck separate from each combat's copy, reaching the method AT ALL is the `pile.Type == PileType.Deck` test Guilty.cs:47 makes, so a removed Guilty stops counting with no extra guard. `combats_seen` is `[SavedProperty] CombatsSeen` and `MAX_COMBATS = 5` is `const int maxCombats` (Guilty.cs:13); at 5 it calls `run.remove_cards([self])`, which fires `Hook.BeforeCardRemoved` exactly as `CardPileCmd.RemoveFromDeck` does.  The stub's premise was checked before the code (PROMPT.md bug class 12) and was false, which is the fifth round running that has held. `RunState.deck` IS the persistent deck and always was.  Pinned by test/test_false_premise_stubs.py.  NOT CLOSED: the DynamicVar('Combats') countdown shown on the card face is presentation.  The text it replaced read: `AfterCombatEnd` increments `CombatsSeen` while the card is in the Deck pile and, at 5, calls `CardPileCmd.RemoveFromDeck(this)` (Guilty.cs:45-56). None of it is ported: the sim's `Card` base has no after-combat hook at all, so Guilty NEVER leaves the deck. The sim's docstring justifies this with "the persistent deck, which the sim doesn't model" -- THAT CLAIM IS FALSE, and it is the same false premise as card/debt's "the sim has no gold": `RunState.deck` is the persistent deck, it survives combats, and RunState already has deck-mutating verbs (`add_card`, `transform_card`, run.py:341-469). Observable across a run: in the game Guilty is a temporary curse that deletes itself after five fights; in the sim it is permanent, so every later draw pile is one dead card heavier for the rest of the run. LIVE. Note this is a rule-1 case -- "the sim does not model the hook" is a GAP, never a waiver -- and the deck IS modelled, so it is live rather than dormant. RATIONALE CITES A THIRD FILE (rule 7): sts2_rl/run.py is not hashed by this record.

ctor.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign): `Card.energy_cost` (`sts2_rl/cards/base.py`) now short-circuits on `self._energy_cost < 0` as its first check, returning the raw canonical value before consulting `_free_this_turn` / `_cost_this_turn` / `_cost_this_combat` / `_cost_delta_this_turn` -- mirrors `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers`'s `if (_base < 0) return num;` short-circuit (`CardEnergyCost.cs:101-104`; the record's `:100-103` cite is one line of decompiler drift), which runs before any local or global modifier. All 29 unplayable curse/status/quest cards now set `self._energy_cost = -1` in `_init_vars` (previously 0), each verified individually against its own C# `base(-1, CardType.X, ...)` constructor -- no exceptions, no ascension-gated cost variant. Readers audit (every non-cards/ `energy_cost` hit read in context): combat play/auto-play/valid_actions/action-mask sites gate on `is_playable` first and never see -1; every global-modifier site routes through `hooks.modify_card_energy_cost`, whose dispatcher ends `return max(0, cost)` -- the sim's analogue of C#'s `Math.Max(0, GetWithModifiers(...))` in `GetAmountToSpend`/`GetResolved` (`CardEnergyCost.cs:134-141`) -- so what is SPENT and what the observation encoder reads (`full_env.py` card_features via `previews.py` preview_card_energy_cost) are byte-for-byte unchanged. The three previously-known readers (`relics/mummified_hand.py`, `potions.py` TouchOfInsanity, `cards/event_cards.py` Enlightenment) remain correct, confirmed by unit tests. NOT closed here: `selectors.py`'s `scripted_card_selector` 'to_draw_top' purpose (Headbutt/Thinking Ahead) ranks by raw `card.energy_cost` unclamped -- a sim-only heuristic with no C# analogue; a curse in a Headbutt-eligible discard pile now ranks below-cost instead of tying at 0. No test exercises it; filed in GAP-QUEUE.md's 'Named work with no entry of its own'. New pins: test/test_unplayable_cost.py (15 tests).  The text it replaced read: CURSE / CURSE / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier and keeps reporting -1; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges -- `GetAmountToSpend()` clamps to 0 on both sides. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1` (relics/mummified_hand.py:25, potions.py:168, cards/event_cards.py:328), and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses.

CanonicalVars.maps_to: nothing -- the sim has no counter at all (guilty.py)
CanonicalVars.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign): (Task 24.) All 23 cards now store their printed C# var under a `_`-attribute (or, for 3 cards whose C# var is a live/computed value at display time -- guilty, normality, expect_a_fight -- a `magic_number` property override; wither similarly overrides `base_damage`) so `Card.base_damage`/`base_block`/`base_hp_loss`/`magic_number` report the C# value instead of the 0/None default. Two additive base.py changes: `_frail` added to `_MAGIC_ATTRS` (shame) and a new `base_gold` property (debt, spoils_map -- GoldVar had no base property at all). feel_no_pain's `_block` was renamed to `_power_amount` (fixing a WRONG value, not just a missing one -- `base_block` no longer misreports it as block-granting; matches Rage/Corruption/Stampede's DynamicVar('Power', ...) convention). Combat behavior / dealt numbers are byte-identical in every case -- a printed-number / observation-encoder fix only. 3 of the 23 (debt, spoils_map, rolling_boulder's secondary IncrementAmount) have NO obs-vector change despite the API fix (full_env.py has no base_gold read site; magic_number carries one number per card and _power_amount dominates rolling_boulder's scan) -- documented, not closed further. CHECKPOINT NOTE for training: encoded VALUES changed for the other 20 cards in feature slots f[17]/f[18] damage, f[20]/f[21] block, f[22] hp_loss, f[23] magic_number; obs LAYOUT unchanged. Pins: test/test_printed_vars.py (48 tests).  The text it replaced read: `new DynamicVar("Combats", 5m)` (Guilty.cs:21) is the COUNTDOWN the card prints, and C# keeps it live: the `[SavedProperty] CombatsSeen` setter writes `DynamicVars["Combats"].BaseValue = 5 - CombatsSeen` (Guilty.cs:25-38), so the card face counts down 5, 4, 3... The sim stores neither the var nor `CombatsSeen`, which follows from the missing AfterCombatEnd. `magic_number` returns None. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bad_luck's CanonicalVars entry (rule 3): a printed DynamicVar with no `_`-attribute in `_init_vars`, so the sim's printed-number API reports the default and `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:455-489) encodes the card wrongly for the policy. DORMANT for game fidelity, LIVE for the observation encoder.
